title: Chapter 352
text:
After playing with the armor for a while, the players finally remembered the difference in attributes between the Sunil Enlistee armor and the ones from the shop.

The same quality, one-third of the price — this was the conscience of the industry!

Everyone was overjoyed, and the remaining people no longer watched. They were willing to fork out the money and transfer it to Han Xiao's account one by one.

"More than fifty people, more than 40,000 Enas. That's about enough to buy two pieces of knowledge …"

Han Xiao chuckled. This was not the end yet!

Then, he opened a new business in the faction store interface — equipment strengthening!

Han Xiao had held back when he was making the armor, and the armor he made could be called the 'Basic Version'. This was to leave room for improvement so that he could carry out the strengthening business!

Repairing and strengthening were long-term income. Han Xiao had many mechanical strengthening skills, and he had the prerequisites to carry out the strengthening business. How could Han Xiao miss out on such a profitable business? Not only that, he also had to control his strength during the strengthening process. He would not go all out on the first strengthening, leaving room for improvement so that the players would continue to spend money.

Han Technician could not be blamed for being greedy. He was doing his job by splitting one item into a few batches to maximize his profits. At the same time, the players who did not know the truth were still willing to do so. Han Xiao used the cheap and high-quality equipment to compete with the other shops. He would first let the players buy the equipment into a trap before launching a follow-up business, turning a one-time sale into long-term profit.

After all, he had occasionally played single player games in his previous life and was inspired to sell them separately.

Han Xiao sighed. Thinking back, he was an honest person when he was young. His young and pure heart was tainted by society. It was not the man's fault for turning bad but the world's fault …

Over the next few days, Han Xiao rushed to make all the armor. Every player changed their appearance and put on the Enlistee armor. It was like the mercenary group had a set of uniforms. Although the players were all Supers, the Enlistee armor also provided some convenience.

As a firm supporter of Han Technician, Mad Blade was the first to spend money to strengthen the armor. After strengthening, the armor's attributes increased by about ten percent, and the price of strengthening the same piece of equipment kept increasing. The first enhancement of the Soldier's Armor only cost 60 Enas, the second enhancement cost 100 Enas, and the third enhancement cost 150 Enas. Every time it was enhanced three times, the price would increase exponentially. The fourth enhancement cost 300 Enas, and so on …

Every attribute enhancement was within 8% to 12%, and the price was low but the benefits were high. Mad Blade set the example, and the others felt that it was reliable and followed suit. After the Sunil missions, the players all had more than 10,000 Enas in their pockets, and they would not feel comfortable if they did not squander them.

Han Xiao had left too much space for the armor to be strengthened. They had to strengthen it at least seven times before they could reach the peak of their abilities. The strengthening business had brought him a total of 23,000 Enas, which meant that more than fifty players had strengthened it more than three times on average!

After selling the armor for more than 40,000 Enas and adding another 23,000 Enas for the subsequent enhancements, Han Xiao now had more than 76,000 Enas in his account, which was more than enough to buy knowledge.

While he was happily selling, Herlous was very troubled. He found Han Xiao and asked with surprise, "How do you know about our Soldier Armor technology?"

Building Sunil's armor himself would definitely cause Herlous to be suspicious. Han Xiao laughed and said, "I derived your blueprints when I was repairing the battlefield. Isn't it awesome?"

Herlous' face twitched. He had secretly learned Sunil's technology and even had a Sunil praise him for being awesome. Even his Battleship Slicing Blade could not cut through such thick skin!

However, Sunil was already in such a state, so there was no need to pursue this. Herlous still had to work together with Han Xiao, so he did not care about this anymore. Furthermore, this was not considered very valuable technology. Most civilizations had basic Soldier Armor, and they just had different styles.

…

Juberly Hub, Regional Exchange.

Han Xiao had earned enough money, so he immediately came to buy Class Advancement Knowledges. The Class Advancement requirement that he had been stuck on for so long was about to be completed, so he was a little excited.

There were only eight Mechanic class Advancement Knowledges in the Colton Star Cluster. Han Xiao scanned through them and chose two Mechanic class Advancement Knowledges.

[Heavy Mechanical Modification], 25 points!

[Advanced Electromagnetism], 37 points!

[Learning … Learning successful!] You have learned [Heavy Mechanical Modification]!

[Learning … Learning successful!] You have learned [Advanced Electromagnetism]!

Class Advancement Requirements: Level 80, 400 INT, 5 Mechanic Class Advancement Knowledges.

Class Advancement Successful!

Detected that the Level 80 Promotion Mission has been completed!

Class Advancement Successful! END bonus increased. 1 END = 40 Health = 50 Stamina!

You have received a new class [Data Mechanic V1]. + 100 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 2 END, + 4 INT. You have received 5 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.

You have learned the skill [Blueprint Improvement]!

You have learned the skill [High Concentration Refining]!

You have learned the skill [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow]!

You have learned the talent [Machinery Analytical Comprehension]!

The energy factor in his body cheered and jumped. With both his Class Advancement and Class Advancement, Han Xiao felt that some kind of shackle had been broken. His vision turned black, and it felt like hours had passed. However, in reality, it had only been half a second. His vision became bright again, and he could sense even more minute things.

Every time his strength increased, he felt like he had been reborn.

A Data Mechanic was also called a Senior Mechanic. When one's understanding of machinery reached a new level, their Machinery Affinity would increase exponentially. Of the four new abilities, [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow] and [Machinery Analytical Comprehension], both greatly increased his Machinery Affinity.

Machinery Affinity was the core attribute of a Mechanic. It represented the speed, attributes, and power of a Mechanic when creating and using machinery. [Magnetic Vision — Data Flow] was an active ability. After activating it, one would enter a special magnetic vision. One's magnetic energy would become an extension of one's senses, and one could use the magnetic field to sense the details of machinery.

Han Xiao directly upgraded this ability to level ten. Its effect was to consume twenty energy every minute and increase his Machinery Affinity by twenty-five to fifty percent. The increase would fluctuate every second, and it was completely random. Because the energy consumption was low, this ability could be activated for a long time. Unlike [Surging Mechanical Force], which could only increase power, this ability could be used on creation.

[Machinery Analytical Comprehension] was a talent. Intelligence would directly increase Machinery Affinity, and the effect was very impressive. Every ten points of Intelligence would increase one's Machinery Affinity by one percent. Currently, Han Xiao had more than four hundred points of Intelligence. This was the key ability of this stage. Increasing Intelligence was a benefit to a Mechanic. From a long-term perspective, this was a very core ability of the Mechanic class.

[High Concentration Refining] was the upgraded version of [Basic Refining]. It increased the strength of raw materials, and its effect was very important. [Blueprint Improvement] was a passive skill. When crafting equipment, there was a chance of activating the effect. The level of the equipment blueprint would temporarily increase by no more than three levels, increasing the attributes of the product. There was also a chance of 'Critical Hit' during the crafting process, creating equipment of higher quality. The chances were dependent on one's intelligence and luck.

Han Xiao still had over 2,500,000,000 EXP. With a wave of his hand, he directly raised these skills to the max level, spending nearly 50,000,000 EXP. Following this, Han Xiao immediately raised his main class to the max level of V15.

After Level 80, the amount of experience required to level up increased exponentially. Each level required tens of millions of experience. Instantly leveling up 15 levels would cost him 900 million experience. He didn't even bat an eye.

[Data Mechanic] leveled up to v15 (x). + 240 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 2 END, + 4 INT. You have received 5 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.

From Level 80 to Level 95! It had even exceeded the upper limit of the players in Version 2.0!

Han Xiao's lead further increased.

The energy in his body suddenly swelled and became vigorous. If it was a small stream in the past, it was now a wide and thick river!

Total Level: 95

Main Class: Mechanic

121 STR, 244 DEX, 214 END, 570 INT, 21 MYS, 14 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 82

Health: 13057

Stamina: 15420

Energy: 5,210 [v9]

Energy Rank: 5,377 Ona

Grade: B

You are a sufficiently strong Super. You can be considered one of the backbone forces in the galaxy. Having evolved to this level, you can look down on most creatures.

"Indeed, my Grade has reached Grade B!" Han Xiao's face was filled with joy. "Just my health alone has increased by more than 5,000 points. My energy has reached 5,000 points, so my overall strength should be forty percent higher than before!"

He had finally crossed the threshold of Grade B, and he already had a certain level of self-protection. His combat strength was far from what a Grade B could compare to. With two new Advancement Knowledges, his combat style could be upgraded!

Han Xiao's heart was filled with the satisfaction of having gained so much.

My status is a little sluggish, and I'm about to start a new storyline, so I'm a little stuck. I'll update once a day for now. Let me adjust for two days before resuming.
